name: Snowflake MCP
description: Dynamically discovers and exposes the tools of one or more Snowflake Cortex Agents MCP servers (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP). All MCP servers share a single Snowflake account and OAuth integration; the `servers[]` array lists the individual MCP endpoints (database/schema/mcp_server) to expose. Tools are discovered on demand (admin Connect + Refresh) and execute per-user via OAuth by default, or with a Programmatic Access Token (PAT) when one is set on the server (`servers[].pat`) or account-wide (`snowflakePat`).
author: AI Playground

snowflakeBaseUrl.title: Snowflake Account URL
snowflakeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of your Snowflake account, e.g. https://xy12345.snowflakecomputing.com

oauthClientId.title: OAuth Client ID
oauthClientId.description: OAUTH_CLIENT_ID from SYSTEM$SHOW_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS('<integration_name>'). Required unless every enabled server uses a PAT.

oauthClientSecret.title: OAuth Client Secret
oauthClientSecret.description: OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET (or OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET_2) from SYSTEM$SHOW_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRETS. Required unless every enabled server uses a PAT.

snowflakePat.title: Programmatic Access Token (PAT)
snowflakePat.description: Optional. Account-wide Snowflake PAT used by every server without its own `pat`, instead of per-user OAuth. All users then share the PAT owner's identity and role.

oauthScope.title: OAuth Scope
oauthScope.description: OAuth scope. Default: 'session:role-any refresh_token'. Use 'session:role:<ROLE>' to pin a specific role.

servers.title: MCP Servers
servers.description: List of Snowflake managed MCP servers to expose. All share the OAuth credentials above.

id.title: Server ID
id.description: Unique identifier used by tools to target this server (lowercase, e.g. 'analytics_cortex')

mcpServerPath.title: MCP Server Path
mcpServerPath.description: Path of the managed MCP server, e.g. /api/v2/databases/MY_DB/schemas/MY_SCHEMA/mcp-servers/MY_MCP

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for a tool call to this server.

pat.title: Programmatic Access Token (PAT)
pat.description: Optional. Snowflake PAT for this server; overrides `snowflakePat` and OAuth. All users then share the PAT owner's identity and role.
